themes.love-relationships-subtitle.en: Understand your love patterns or one specific relationship.
themes.love-relationships-subtitle.zh: 了解你的爱情模式，或深入分析一段具体关系。

themes.career-purpose-subtitle.en: See your work pattern, current phase and direction.
themes.career-purpose-subtitle.zh: 看清你的工作模式、当前阶段与方向。

themes.career-purpose-subtitle.pt-BR: Veja seu padrão de trabalho, fase atual e direção.
themes.career-purpose-subtitle.ko: 일의 패턴, 현재 단계와 방향을 살펴보세요.

themes.money-growth-subtitle.en: Explore resources, security, priorities and growth.
themes.money-growth-subtitle.zh: 探索资源、安全感、优先级与成长。

themes.money-growth-subtitle.fr: Explorez les ressources, la sécurité, les priorités et la croissance.

themes.money-growth-subtitle.de: Erkunde Ressourcen, Sicherheit, Prioritäten und Wachstum.
themes.money-growth-subtitle.it: Esplora risorse, sicurezza, priorità e crescita.
themes.money-growth-subtitle.pt-BR: Explore recursos, segurança, prioridades e crescimento.

themes.family-home-subtitle.en: Understand home, roots and the relationships closest to you.
themes.family-home-subtitle.zh: 理解家庭、根基，以及与你最亲近的人之间的关系。
themes.family-home-subtitle.es: Comprende el hogar, las raíces y tus relaciones más cercanas.
themes.family-home-subtitle.fr: Comprenez le foyer, les racines et vos relations les plus proches.
themes.family-home-subtitle.tr: Yuva, kökler ve en yakın ilişkilerinizi anlayın.
themes.family-home-subtitle.de: Verstehe Zuhause, Wurzeln und deine engsten Beziehungen.
themes.family-home-subtitle.it: Comprendi casa, radici e le relazioni più vicine.

themes.self-wellbeing-subtitle.en: Read your inner climate, energy, pressure and recovery.
themes.self-wellbeing-subtitle.zh: 了解你的内在状态、能量、压力与恢复节奏。
themes.self-wellbeing-subtitle.es: Lee tu clima interior, energía, presión y recuperación.
themes.self-wellbeing-subtitle.fr: Lisez votre climat intérieur, votre énergie, vos tensions et votre récupération.
themes.self-wellbeing-subtitle.tr: İç dünyanızı, enerjinizi, baskıyı ve toparlanmayı okuyun.

themes.self-wellbeing-subtitle.it: Leggi il tuo clima interiore, energia, pressione e recupero.
themes.self-wellbeing-subtitle.pt-BR: Entenda seu clima interno, energia, pressão e recuperação.
themes.self-wellbeing-subtitle.ko: 내면 상태, 에너지, 압박과 회복 흐름을 살펴보세요.

themes.creativity-expression-subtitle.en: Explore your creative voice, projects and momentum.
themes.creativity-expression-subtitle.zh: 探索你的创作方式、个人项目与推进节奏。

themes.creativity-expression-subtitle.fr: Explorez votre voix créative, vos projets et votre élan.
themes.creativity-expression-subtitle.tr: Yaratıcı sesinizi, projelerinizi ve ivmenizi keşfedin.
themes.creativity-expression-subtitle.de: Erkunde kreativen Ausdruck, Projekte und Dynamik.
themes.creativity-expression-subtitle.it: Esplora la tua voce creativa, i progetti e lo slancio.
themes.creativity-expression-subtitle.pt-BR: Explore sua voz criativa, projetos e ritmo.

themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.en: See how learning, skills, travel and new perspectives develop.
themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.zh: 看清学习、技能、旅行与新视角如何展开。
themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.es: Observa cómo evolucionan el aprendizaje, las habilidades, los viajes y nuevas perspectivas.
themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.fr: Voyez comment évoluent l’apprentissage, les compétences, les voyages et les nouvelles perspectives.
themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.tr: Öğrenme, beceriler, seyahat ve yeni bakışların nasıl geliştiğini görün.
themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.de: Sieh, wie Lernen, Fähigkeiten, Reisen und neue Perspektiven sich entwickeln.
themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.it: Scopri come evolvono apprendimento, competenze, viaggi e nuove prospettive.
themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.pt-BR: Veja como aprendizado, habilidades, viagens e novas perspectivas se desenvolvem.
themes.learning-exploration-subtitle.ko: 배움, 기술, 여행과 새로운 관점의 흐름을 살펴보세요.

themes.life-direction-subtitle.en: Bring your current chapter and long-term direction into one view.
themes.life-direction-subtitle.zh: 把当前人生章节与长期方向放在一起理解。

themes.life-direction-subtitle.fr: Reliez votre chapitre actuel à votre direction à long terme.
themes.life-direction-subtitle.tr: Mevcut yaşam bölümünüzü ve uzun vadeli yönünüzü birlikte görün.
themes.life-direction-subtitle.de: Betrachte aktuelle Lebensphase und langfristige Richtung gemeinsam.
themes.life-direction-subtitle.it: Unisci il capitolo attuale e la direzione a lungo termine.
themes.life-direction-subtitle.pt-BR: Integre seu momento atual e sua direção de longo prazo.
themes.life-direction-subtitle.ko: 현재 삶의 장과 장기 방향을 함께 살펴보세요.

themes.context-note.en: Your note guides the interpretation but does not change chart data.
themes.context-note.zh: 补充信息只用于帮助解读，不会改变星盘计算。
themes.context-note.es: Tu nota guía la interpretación, pero no cambia los datos de la carta.
themes.context-note.fr: Votre note guide l’interprétation sans modifier les données astrologiques.
themes.context-note.tr: Notunuz yorumu yönlendirir, harita verilerini değiştirmez.
themes.context-note.de: Deine Notiz lenkt die Deutung, ändert aber keine Horoskopdaten.
themes.context-note.it: La nota guida l’interpretazione, ma non cambia i dati del tema.
themes.context-note.pt-BR: Sua nota orienta a interpretação, mas não altera os dados do mapa.
themes.context-note.ko: 메모는 해석의 맥락만 제공하며 차트 계산은 바꾸지 않습니다.

themes.calculation-failed.en: We couldn't calculate all required charts. No credits were used.
themes.calculation-failed.zh: 无法完成全部所需星盘计算，本次不会扣除 Credits。
themes.calculation-failed.es: No pudimos calcular todas las cartas necesarias. No se usaron créditos.
themes.calculation-failed.fr: Impossible de calculer toutes les cartes requises. Aucun crédit n’a été utilisé.
themes.calculation-failed.tr: Gerekli tüm haritalar hesaplanamadı. Kredi kullanılmadı.
themes.calculation-failed.de: Nicht alle erforderlichen Horoskope konnten berechnet werden. Es wurden keine Credits verwendet.
themes.calculation-failed.it: Non è stato possibile calcolare tutti i temi richiesti. Nessun credito è stato usato.
themes.calculation-failed.pt-BR: Não foi possível calcular todos os mapas necessários. Nenhum crédito foi usado.
themes.calculation-failed.ko: 필요한 차트를 모두 계산하지 못했습니다. 크레딧은 사용되지 않았습니다.

themes.ai-consent.message.en: To generate Written Analysis, allow AI report assistance. Your calculated chart results will be sent through Interstellar Relay. Two Credits are charged only after the report is verified and saved.
themes.ai-consent.message.zh: 如需生成文字分析，请允许 AI 报告辅助。已计算的星盘结果会通过 Interstellar Relay 发送；仅在报告验证并保存成功后扣除 2 个 Credits。
themes.ai-consent.message.es: Para generar el análisis escrito, permite la asistencia de IA para informes. Los resultados calculados se enviarán mediante Interstellar Relay. Solo se cobrarán dos Credits después de verificar y guardar el informe.
themes.ai-consent.message.fr: Pour générer l’analyse écrite, autorisez l’assistance IA aux rapports. Les résultats calculés seront envoyés via Interstellar Relay. Deux Credits ne seront débités qu’après validation et enregistrement du rapport.
themes.ai-consent.message.tr: Yazılı Analiz oluşturmak için AI rapor desteğine izin verin. Hesaplanan harita sonuçları Interstellar Relay üzerinden gönderilir. İki Credit yalnızca rapor doğrulanıp kaydedildikten sonra düşülür.
themes.ai-consent.message.de: Erlaube die KI-Berichtshilfe, um die Textanalyse zu erstellen. Deine berechneten Horoskopergebnisse werden über Interstellar Relay gesendet. Zwei Credits werden erst nach Prüfung und Speicherung des Berichts berechnet.
themes.ai-consent.message.it: Per generare l’analisi scritta, consenti l’assistenza AI ai report. I risultati calcolati verranno inviati tramite Interstellar Relay. Due Credits vengono addebitati solo dopo la verifica e il salvataggio del report.
themes.ai-consent.message.pt-BR: Para gerar a análise escrita, permita a assistência de IA para relatórios. Os resultados calculados serão enviados pelo Interstellar Relay. Dois Credits serão cobrados somente após a verificação e o salvamento do relatório.
themes.ai-consent.message.ko: 서면 분석을 생성하려면 AI 보고서 지원을 허용하세요. 계산된 차트 결과는 Interstellar Relay를 통해 전송됩니다. 보고서가 검증되고 저장된 뒤에만 Credit 2개가 차감됩니다.

themes.report.preparing-detail.en: Combining your chart and timing evidence.
themes.report.preparing-detail.zh: 正在综合你的基础盘与时间证据。
themes.report.preparing-detail.es: Combinando la carta y la evidencia temporal.
themes.report.preparing-detail.fr: Synthèse de vos cartes et des éléments temporels.
themes.report.preparing-detail.it: Stiamo integrando tema e indicazioni temporali.
themes.report.preparing-detail.pt-BR: Combinando seu mapa e as evidências de timing.

themes.report.failed-detail.en: Your charts are ready, but the written analysis could not be generated.
themes.report.failed-detail.zh: 星盘已经准备好，但暂时无法生成文字分析。
themes.report.failed-detail.es: Tus cartas están listas, pero no se pudo generar el análisis escrito.
themes.report.failed-detail.fr: Vos cartes sont prêtes, mais l’analyse écrite n’a pas pu être générée.
themes.report.failed-detail.tr: Haritalarınız hazır, ancak yazılı analiz oluşturulamadı.
themes.report.failed-detail.de: Deine Horoskope sind fertig, die Textanalyse konnte jedoch nicht erstellt werden.
themes.report.failed-detail.it: I temi sono pronti, ma non è stato possibile generare l’analisi scritta.
themes.report.failed-detail.pt-BR: Seus mapas estão prontos, mas não foi possível gerar a análise escrita.
themes.report.failed-detail.ko: 차트는 준비되었지만 텍스트 분석을 생성하지 못했습니다.

themes.report-consent-required.en: Enable AI reports in Settings to generate the written analysis.
themes.report-consent-required.zh: 请先在设置中启用 AI 报告，再生成文字分析。
themes.report-consent-required.es: Activa los informes de IA en Ajustes para generar el análisis escrito.
themes.report-consent-required.fr: Activez les rapports IA dans Réglages pour générer l’analyse écrite.
themes.report-consent-required.tr: Yazılı analiz için Ayarlar'da AI raporlarını etkinleştirin.
themes.report-consent-required.de: Aktiviere KI-Berichte in den Einstellungen, um die Textanalyse zu erstellen.
themes.report-consent-required.it: Attiva i report AI nelle Impostazioni per generare l’analisi scritta.
themes.report-consent-required.pt-BR: Ative os relatórios de IA nos Ajustes para gerar a análise escrita.
themes.report-consent-required.ko: 설정에서 AI 리포트를 켜야 텍스트 분석을 생성할 수 있습니다.

themes.report-offline.en: Connect to the internet to generate the written analysis.
themes.report-offline.zh: 连接网络后即可生成文字分析。
themes.report-offline.es: Conéctate a internet para generar el análisis escrito.
themes.report-offline.fr: Connectez-vous à Internet pour générer l’analyse écrite.
themes.report-offline.de: Verbinde dich mit dem Internet, um die Textanalyse zu erstellen.
themes.report-offline.it: Connettiti a Internet per generare l’analisi scritta.
themes.report-offline.pt-BR: Conecte-se à internet para gerar a análise escrita.
themes.report-offline.ko: 인터넷에 연결하면 텍스트 분석을 생성할 수 있습니다.
